project.name: Æion Factory
project.description: A repository template that lets coding agents work under shared instructions, checked specifications and safety guards, with Python 3 and the agent only.

sources.locator: owner request, 2026-11-09: factory 3.0.0 on Python 3 and an agent, AxiomSpec integrated

data.description: A spec is data: it is parsed strictly, validated against the closed schema and gated, and a gate that could not run is unknown.
data.success_measure: Every spec change passes G01-G03 before it is committed; no unknown is ever reported as pass.

nodes.title: Agents receive exact and complete context

data.description: Before a change, an agent gets the obligations, rules, decisions and tests it must respect, from declared links, not from guesses.
data.success_measure: A change's packet holds every mandatory item, split rather than cut, and names what it could not map.

nodes.title: Evidence names the inputs it ran on

data.description: A test result counts only for the specification and source tree it was produced on.
data.success_measure: A receipt is current only for its exact spec digest and source-tree digest.

nodes.title: Documentation is derived, current and safe

data.description: The cockpit, pages, diagrams and exported features come from the spec by code, and spec text never becomes markup.
data.success_measure: Generated files match their inputs byte for byte, and no spec value adds a heading, link or check.

nodes.title: Secrets never reach an agent session

data.description: The shared guards refuse recognized secret reads before any harness runs the command.
data.success_measure: Every guarded harness refuses the recognized secret reads in the guard tests.

nodes.title: Python 3 and a coding agent are enough

data.description: The factory's checks, graph, docs and diagrams need no virtual environment, browser or Node install.
data.success_measure: factory-tests passes with Python 3 alone; JavaScript adapter suites are reported as not run, never as passed.

data.trigger: an input holds duplicate keys, a float, NaN, an unsafe integer or trailing data
data.subject: axiom toolkit
data.response: refuse it as a G01 input error before any schema check

data.subject: axiom toolkit
data.response: report each phase as the worst of its required gates, in the order error, fail, unknown, pass

nodes.title: Keep exhausted or missing evaluation unknown

data.trigger: a constraint evaluation exceeds its step budget or lacks observation data
data.subject: axiom toolkit
data.response: report the result as unknown, never as pass

data.trigger: a query name matches several nodes or none
data.subject: axiom toolkit
data.response: list the candidates with exit 3, or answer not found with exit 4, without guessing

nodes.title: Split context rather than cut it

data.trigger: a change's mandatory context exceeds the packet budget
data.subject: axiom toolkit
data.response: split the packet into parts and keep every mandatory item

data.trigger: a changed file maps to no binding
data.subject: axiom toolkit
data.response: mark the packet incomplete and name the unmapped file

nodes.title: Invalidate evidence on a spec change

data.trigger: the spec changed after a test run
data.subject: axiom toolkit
data.response: report that run's receipt as stale

nodes.title: Invalidate evidence on a code change

data.trigger: code, tests or configuration changed after a test run
data.subject: axiom toolkit
data.response: report that run's receipt as stale

data.trigger: a generated page or diagram differs from what its inputs produce
data.subject: axiom toolkit
data.response: fail axiom check and name the stale file

data.subject: axiom toolkit
data.response: escape every spec value for the Markdown or SVG it is written into

data.trigger: a spec value contains a line break, heading or checklist line
data.subject: axiom toolkit
data.response: flatten it to one line so the exported feature keeps exactly its eight sections and its own acceptance items

data.trigger: an agent command reads a secret file
data.subject: shared guard
data.response: refuse the command before the harness runs it

nodes.title: Report JavaScript suites as not run

data.subject: factory test runner
data.response: report the JavaScript adapter suites as not run and the Python suites as the result

data.subject: repository health check
data.response: leave a top-level folder that release archives omit out of the folder cap

data.oracle: Each malformed input raises InputError with its stable code; nothing is parsed further.
A valid document returns the same values, with booleans and integers kept distinct.

nodes.title: CLI exit codes follow the contract

data.oracle: The real command exits 0 on a ready spec, 2 with an open blocking decision, 4 on a duplicate key.
A phase with an unknown gate is unknown; adding a fail makes it fail; adding an error makes it error.
On the unmodified reference ledger, G01-G06 are pass and G07 is fail, as its walkthrough states.
500 rows give unknown with a budget reason; 100 rows give pass.
An observation without its collection evaluates to unknown, never to an empty collection.
All 45 Boolean expectations of the nine ledger observations match.
The real command reports 45 of 45 expectations matching and exits 0.
Clearing a blocking decision's answer makes G04 fail with OPEN_BLOCKING_DECISION.
A partial path is not found (4); a symbol defined twice is ambiguous (3) with both candidates.
A 600-byte budget gives several parts with the same items and closure digest as the whole packet.
A file change seeds its requirement and brings dependents, decisions, tests, components, bindings, actors and sources.
The real command prints a complete packet and the check passes once docs are generated.
A file with no binding and an unknown ID make the packet incomplete and are both named.
After a real run, editing the spec makes the receipt stale.

nodes.title: A run writes a current receipt

data.oracle: The adapter runs the bound test, records one pass, and the receipt is current.
After a real run, editing a source file makes the receipt stale, naming code as the reason.
Generated docs check clean; a hand edit is reported as stale or edited.
An HTML tag and a link in a title appear escaped, never as markup.
A script tag in a label is escaped and the SVG still parses.
Flow, sequence, use-case and state views render to well-formed, byte-identical SVG twice.
A response holding a heading and a checklist line exports with exactly eight sections and no forged item.

nodes.title: A feature has eight sections and checks

data.oracle: The exported feature has the eight sections in order, the test's acceptance item and the delivery steps.
A 1,000-byte profile limit refuses the export and writes no feature file.

nodes.title: Secret command refused by the real guard

data.oracle: cat .env is refused for Codex, OpenCode and Pi through the shared guard; an ordinary event passes.
Native read ranges and edit kinds pass the shared intake guards unchanged.

nodes.title: Secret files are never read by the graph

data.oracle: A .env file in the project is absent from the graph's nodes.
Ten folders fail the cap; marking demo export-ignore makes it pass and lists demo as not shipped.

data.responsibility: Validates the canonical spec, builds the knowledge graph, answers bounded queries and packets, renders docs and diagrams, exports features and runs bound tests.
data.boundary: tools/axiom: a local process reading and writing project files only

data.responsibility: Refuse secret reads and dangerous commands before any harness runs them.
data.boundary: .claude/hooks and tools/agents/hook.py, called by every harness adapter

data.responsibility: Score repository caps and run every factory test suite as CI does.

data.definition: The one knowledge/spec/spec.json of a project, format axiomspec/0.1; every other document is derived from it or explains it.
A JSON record of one executed test case: results, counts, spec digest and source-tree digest. Local and untrusted.
The mandatory closure of a change (AX-K-010), rendered for a coding agent and split under a byte budget.

data.question: Where does a project's canonical specification live?
options: spec/spec.json at the root, as the AxiomSpec playbook layout
data.rationale: A new project has eight factory folders and a cap of nine: a root spec/ would leave the product no folder (demo/check found it). knowledge/ already holds canonical knowledge, and AxiomSpec asks to adapt its layout to the repository's conventions.

data.question: Which extractors feed the knowledge graph?
options: Python ast and an ECMAScript lexical scan, no model
A pinned third-party graph tool in a virtual environment
data.answer: Python ast and an ECMAScript lexical scan, no model
data.rationale: The owner asked for Python 3 and an agent only; declared spec links carry the meaning, extraction only adds structure.

data.question: How are documentation diagrams rendered?
options: SVG from structured JSON views, standard library only
Mermaid or PlantUML text rendered by a browser or Java
data.answer: SVG from structured JSON views, standard library only
data.rationale: No runtime beyond Python, and labels stay data instead of diagram syntax.

data.claim: Python 3.12 or later is available wherever the factory runs.
data.validation_method: factory-tests on the CI runner and on the owner's machine (3.15.2).

data.asset: spec text rendered into docs and exported features
data.threat: a value adds a heading, link or acceptance item
data.impact: a reader or a build factory trusts a forged obligation

data.description: Escape every value for its output context and flatten exported values to one line, then verify the eight-section structure before writing.

nodes.title: Huge integer is an input error

data.oracle: An integer of 5000 digits raises InputError UNSAFE_INTEGER; nothing is parsed further.

nodes.title: Gates after a G01 failure are not run

data.oracle: With a G01 error, every later gate is reported unknown (NOT_RUN) and the status stays error.

nodes.title: Out of window is not pass

data.oracle: A constraint effective from 2030 evaluated in 2026 is unknown NOT_IN_EFFECT; an invalid time is unknown; in window it holds.
A non-object property schema or a bad pattern is a G03 error, never a traceback.

nodes.title: A receipt counts for its own test only

data.oracle: A receipt naming another test, or one that is not an object, is failed, not current.
A test importing its own common module passes through the isolated adapter.

nodes.title: Init keeps a project's own docs

data.oracle: init in a project with its own docs/README.md and docs/generated/api.html exits 1 and leaves both unchanged.

nodes.title: A profile cannot rename the export

data.oracle: A profile setting file and id leaves the computed file name and id; nothing is written outside the output folder.

nodes.title: Only knowledge and docs cite the spec

data.oracle: A ticket key in notes/ is ignored; an unknown ID in docs/ is reported.
